author: (C.Agardh) Ambronn, 1880

note.en: A tiny creeping red weed that grows on rock and as a rare epiphyte on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita.
note.es: Un alga roja diminuta y rastrera que crece sobre roca y como epífito raro en el pasto de tortuga en Punta Cahuita.

evidence: Samper-Villarreal et al. 2008: rare on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita
GBIF herbarium specimen: Puerto Limón (Dawson and Rudersdorf)

sources.t: Samper-Villarreal, Bernecker & Wehrtmann 2008, Inventory of macroalgal epiphytes on Thalassia testudinum in Parque Nacional Cahuita, Revista de Biología Tropical 56 (Suppl. 4)
